title: EMP-EVAL: A Framework for Measuring Empathy in Open Domain Dialogues
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark did not measure any aspect of faith or religion. It was designed to measure empathy in open-domain dialogues, using data from mental health support subreddits.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion.
